verdict.rationale: The evidence documents time-based scheduling, backfills, and pipeline chaining on dltHub (dlt-docs-11, dlt-docs-59, dlt-docs-70). It does not document user-defined rules that fire actions automatically when an event occurs. A recurring schedule is not an event trigger, and the one-line 'chain their pipelines' marketing claim does not show a rule or event-trigger mechanism, so only adjacent capabilities are evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
